Because a calendar year is about 365 days while 52 weeks are only 364 days, Apple periodically adds a 53rd week to keep the fiscal year aligned with the calendar. **Fiscal 2023 was one of those 53-week years**, while fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 were normal 52-week years.

- In other words, FY2024 revenue would need to be roughly one week’s worth of revenue higher just to offset the fact that FY2023 had an extra week.

This is a common “fiscal calendar” distortion. Companies often quantify or adjust for such effects so investors can compare underlying performance on a consistent 52-week basis.
